content.title: Leonardo DiCaprio Brings Girlfriend Vittoria Ceretti to 2026 Oscars in Rare Public Date Night
content.text: Vittoria Ceretti, Leonardo DiCaprio and Teyana Taylor at 2026 Oscars. Credit : Roger Kisby/The Academy via Getty NEED TO KNOW Leonardo DiCaprio and Vittoria Ceretti made their awards show debut as a couple at the 2026 Oscars on Sunday, March 15The One Battle After Another star and his model girlfriend didn't walk the red carpet together but sat beside each other inside the ceremonyDiCaprio is nominated for his role in One Battle After Another in the Best Actor category Leonardo DiCaprio cozied up to Vittoria Ceretti at the 2026 Oscars. The One Battle After Another star, 51, had a rare public date night with his longtime girlfriend, 27, when they attended the prestigious awards show celebrating the best in film at the Dolby Theater in Los Angeles on Sunday, March 15. DiCaprio, who's nominated for Best Actor at this year's ceremony, suited up in a Dior tux opposite his model partner, who made her Academy Awards debut. In fact, the outing marked the first time the couple attended the Oscars together since they began dating around three years ago. Leonardo DiCaprio at the 2026 Oscars. ANGELA WEISS / AFP via Getty Their appearance at the awards show isn't the only thing that debuted by the couple. For DiCaprio's part, he debuted a mustache upon his arrival on the red carpet, marking a comeback of the actor's facial hair with a bold, stylish statement. He wore a black tuxedo and a matching black bowtie. For added charm, he pinned a vintage golden bee brooch onto the left lapel of his jacket (a nod to Bee:wild, under the Re:wild umbrella, which was co-founded by DiCaprio), and further accessorized with a Rolex watch on his left wrist. The model wore a maroon Alaïa dress, which was on display when the broadcast flashed to the couple sitting alongside each other inside the ceremony. She kept the custom piece on for her appearance at Vanity Fair's afterparty. Leonardo DiCaprio and Vittoria Ceretti. Jon Kopaloff/WireImage; Jon Kopaloff/Getty Images for Vanity Fair DiCaprio and Ceretti have never attended a U.S. awards show together before the 2026 Oscars. The Best Actor nominee has been intentional about keeping his relationships private. The actor brought his mother, Irmelin Indenbirken, 82, as his date to the 2026 Golden Globe Awards and the BAFTAs. The mother-son duo shares a close connection and has attended major award shows alongside each other in the past. One Battle After Another earned 13 nominations, including DiCaprio's Best Actor nod. While the show is still ongoing, the film has already won for Best Adapted Screenplay (Paul Thomas Anderson), Best Supporting Actor (Sean Penn) and Best Casting. Benicio del Toro and Leonardo DiCaprio attend the 2026 Oscars. DiCaprio and Ceretti have been dating for nearly three years, dating back to around August 2023. In photos obtained by Page Six, the duo were pictured strolling around Santa Barbara, Calif., while enjoying iced coffees and ice cream cones. "She is very cute, sweet and charming. Leo seems to really like her," a source told PEOPLE in April 2024 of DiCaprio and Ceretti's then-budding romance at the time. In April 2025, the model posed for the cover of Vogue France. In it, she told the magazine that dating someone as famous as DiCaprio is "something you learn." "If what you're experiencing is real, if you know you love each other, then there's no reason to be alarmed," she said. "Because love protects and gives confidence."
